row.title: A loop's own output must pass the check that gates main
row.body: The research loop appended plain JSON rows to ops/research/outcomes.jsonl; openstd --check reads that as a bespoke format, so main went red after a [skip ci] loop commit and the merge lane, which merges only on green, stalled every PR. The loop now writes CloudEvents 1.0 rows, migrates legacy rows on apply, and a test runs the loop's real output through the standards check.

title: A loop's own output must pass the check that gates main
